Text to speech, speech to text, sound effects, music and voice changing.

## API key

1. Open [elevenlabs.io](https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from ElevenLabs' API keys page.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add elevenlabs
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  elevenlabs: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls ElevenLabs's [API](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/introduction) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show elevenlabs` shows the key as set.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20ElevenLabs).
